Panel certificate
The panel is using a self-signed certificate — browsers show a warning. Get a real certificate for your panel domain below.
Choose a panel address, such as panel.example.com. At its current DNS provider, point an A record to this server’s public IPv4 address. Use an AAAA record only with working IPv6.
Wait until the address resolves to this server and inbound port 80 is reachable for certificate validation. A local DNS engine is not required for this panel certificate.
Enter the address below and request the certificate. This secures the panel; website certificates are managed separately in each domain.
Panel domain
Get certificate

The domain must already resolve to this server and port 80 must be reachable. certbot is installed on first use; renewal is automatic afterwards. The panel restarts for a few seconds.
